title: サイレンススズカ、覚醒④

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's October. Propelled by the glow of the limelight and high expectations, a certain Umamusume breaks into a frenzied run.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: What incredible speed! Silence Suzuka pulls even further away from the pack with her runaway style!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Is it even safe runnin' that fast?!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: She's made it past the giant zelkova tree, but the other runners are hot on her trail…

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: But no! She ramps up her speed even more on the straight! No one can close the gap!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: This is amazing! Go, Suzuka! Go, go, gooo!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka holds the lead all the way to the finish line! A fitting run for the Otherworldly Front-Runner!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Since that trip to Hong Kong, all her races have been incredible as all get-out! She's the cream of the Umamusume crop, I tell ya what!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's a real strength to her running, but that's not all. Her style captures the hearts of those who witness it and refuses to let go.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer! Suzuka's off to the winner's circle!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna give her a big ol' victory squeeze! C'mon, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, we can't even get to the sidelines—the swarm of Suzuka's celebrating fans is too vast to push through.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Once again, I'm reminded of the hold that Silence Suzuka has on everyone's hearts.
